# Sushanth Paatnaik

> Inventor, deep-tech founder, and six-time Indian Presidential awardee building graphene, nano-materials, and industrial systems from India for the world.

Founder of Monoatom Labs, Grafillium, SPI Industries, InThinks and Starunico Capital. CIO at Magppie. Engineering matter, capital, and scale.

- [Ventures](/ventures): Operating group across materials, industrial products, AI, and capital.
- [Recognitions](/recognitions): Six Presidential awards, TED, MIT TR-35, NASA, NIF-India IGNITE.
